verdicts.reason: A is the better resize because its headline is far more readable at banner size. A's headline is large and legible on one line, but it runs almost edge to edge with almost no right margin, and the CTA is jammed into the bottom-left corner beside an empty bottom-right area. B keeps the original's centred stack, but at 320x50 the headline is tiny (about 9px), leaves big dead orange areas on both sides, ignores the left-to-right banner format, and its CTA nearly touches the bottom edge.
